note: Platforms solquicks uses and gets a referral credit from. Each entry needs a logo in img/referrals/ (written root-absolute, "/img/referrals/x.jpg", so it also loads on /c/<slug> creator pages), what the platform does, and what the visitor gets for using the link. `youGet` is a promise to the reader: say what joining actually gives them, never a signup bonus unless the referral dashboard confirms one exists. The Referrals tab does not appear at all while items is empty.

items.name: Superteam Talent
items.what: The Solana ecosystem's talent platform. One profile, matched continuously with the teams that are hiring.
items.youGet: A profile that gets matched with active roles, the job board, and your interviews tracked in one place.

items.name: Sat Rush
items.what: Bitcoin mining you take part in by depositing, rather than by running hardware.
items.youGet: A share of a mining operation without buying, powering or cooling a single machine.

items.name: Meteora
items.what: Liquidity pools on Solana. Put a pair to work and earn a share of what trades through it.
items.youGet: Your pair earning a cut of everything that trades through it, with the pool types and fee settings laid out rather than hidden.

items.name: Sanctum
items.what: Liquid staking on Solana. Stake SOL for the yield and keep a token you can still use elsewhere.
items.youGet: Staking yield on your SOL while keeping a token you can still lend, trade or supply elsewhere.

items.name: Titan
items.what: A Solana swap router — the one whose routing is coming to the swap on this site.
items.youGet: Routing across Solana venues at once, so a trade is filled at the best price any of them offers.

items.name: JungleFun
items.what: Gacha packs of Solana NFTs, built by MonkeDAO and MagicBlock. Open a pack, see what you pull.
items.youGet: Packs you open yourself, with the odds published up front and the pulls yours to keep, sell or trade.

items.name: D3 Frontier
items.what: ICANN is adding over a thousand new internet extensions — .agent, .crypto, .btc and the rest. The last time the list grew was 2012. Frontier is where you earn priority on the names before they launch.
items.youGet: 10,000 points the moment you join, which go towards priority on the names you want. Priority, not a reservation — no name is guaranteed, and deposits sit in third-party vaults rather than with D3.

items.name: KAST
items.what: A dollar account and a Visa card, run on stablecoins. Open a US or EU account from anywhere, hold digital dollars, and spend them at 150 million merchants across 170+ countries.
items.youGet: Somewhere to hold and spend dollars without a US bank, cashback on what you spend, and 8% on an idle balance on the free tier. They call it a reward rather than interest, the current rate is introductory and changes in July 2027, and the higher cashback and 12% rate are paid memberships.

items.name: Doma
items.what: Domain names turned into tokens you can trade. Each name has a token with its own price and a buyout price that takes the domain itself.
items.youGet: A market for names rather than a registrar: you can hold a share of a domain, or pay its buyout price and take the name outright. It is speculation — prices are quoted as multiples, many names are still on a bonding curve, and what you hold is only worth what the next person pays.
